assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md Step 2 trace shows: 'section_name = line[3:]  # Extracts heading text after "## "' and 'When the heading line is `## Migration Patterns  \n`, `line[3:]` produces `"Migration Patterns  "` (with trailing spaces)'. Step 3 states defect location: '`line[3:]` heading extraction does not call `.strip()` on the extracted section name'. Decomposition Guard confirms: 'This bug has a single root cause: the `line[3:]` heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md Root Cause section states WHAT: 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which captures everything after the `## ` prefix without stripping trailing whitespace'. WHERE: Affected Files lists 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention conformance analysis section, heading extraction logic (`line[3:]`)' and 'convention-aware task enrichment section, exact-match lookup'. HOW TO VERIFY: Reproducer Strategy section specifies '1. Create a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on a heading (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  ` with two trailing spaces)' with assertions for correct extraction.
